meta.name: terraform-module-library
meta.description: Build reusable Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI infrastructure following infrastructure-as-code best practices. Use when creating infrastructure modules, standardizing cloud provisioning, or implementing reusable IaC components.

copy.tagline: 用代码构建跨云可复用的基础设施模块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为多云环境编写可复用的Terraform模块。
copy.tagline_en: Build reusable infrastructure modules across clouds with code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're writing reusable Terraform modules for multi-cloud infrastructure.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按标准结构编写可复用的 Terraform 模块,用于在 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI 等云平台部署和管理基础设施,并生成示例、最佳实践及 Terratest 测试。
howto.when: 当你说要创建基础设施模块、标准化云资源供应,或实现可复用的基础设施即代码组件时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 AWS VPC 的 Terraform 模块
say.note: Claude 会按标准结构生成模块文件。

say.text: 按最佳实践搭建一个 Terraform 模块结构
say.note: Claude 会列出目录结构和文件清单。

say.text: 给这个模块写个 Terratest 测试
say.note: Claude 会生成 Go 测试代码。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude writes reusable Terraform modules following a standard structure for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI, producing example usage, best practices, and Terratest tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create infrastructure modules, standardize cloud provisioning, or implement reusable IaC components.

say_en.text: Create an AWS VPC Terraform module for me.
say_en.note: Claude will generate module files per standard pattern.

say_en.text: Set up a Terraform module structure following best practices.
say_en.note: Claude will list directory structure and files.

say_en.text: Write a Terratest for this module.
say_en.note: Claude will produce Go test code.
